have optimized the layout alignment, refined the cake sizing, and scaled up the message typography to ensure a beautiful, overlap-free sequence:
Perfect Spacing & Zero Overlap:
Adjusted the vertical target of the aligned balloons to sit slightly higher (top: 180px on desktop, top: 130px on mobile) to hover neatly under the main banner.
Positioned the cake container downward and scaled the cake to a balanced 0.85x size. This guarantees a generous, clean visual gap between the aligned balloons and the cake.
Enhanced Birthday Message Font Size:
Desktop: Increased the letter message font size from 28px to an elegant 36px with a comfortable 1.6 line-height for a premium, readable feel.
Tablet: Increased font size to 28px.
Mobile: Scaled up font size to 22px so it fills mobile frames beautifully without clutterin
